c9181063ed3959e8.description: المسمى الوظيفي: موظفة مبيعات — بوثات مكان العمل: النخيل مول أو الحمراء مول، حسب التوزيع المعتمد. المبادرة والترحيب: استقبال العملاء بابتسامة وسلوك إيجابي، والمبادرة بدعوة المارة للتعرّف على المنتجات إتمام البيع وزيادة قيمة الفاتورة: توضيح الأسعار والعروض وشروطها قبل الدفع، ومساعدة العميل على اتخاذ القرار، واقتراح قطع إضافية مناسبة لاحتياجه. تشغيل الكاشير: تسجيل جميع المبيعات وإصدار الفواتير، والتحقق من الدفع، وتطبيق سياسة الاستبدال والاسترجاع المعتمدة. لا تُمنح خصومات أو وعود خارج الصلاحيات المحددة. متابعة المخزون والعهدة: عدّ البضاعة المستلمة والتحقق من مطابقتها، وتنظيم مخزون البوث، والإبلاغ عن النواقص والمقاسات المطلوبة والتلف أو الفروقات فور اكتشافها. تُوثّق أي حركة بضاعة حسب الإجراء المعتمد. المتطلبات الأساسية: لباقة وحسن تعامل، قدرة على المبادرة والإقناع، دقة وأمانة، واستعداد للعمل بنظام الورديات. تُفضّل الخبرة السابقة في المبيعات وخدمة العملاء.

c91eb143ef9ea052.description: نبحث عن مستشارات مبيعات عقارية شغوفات للانضمام إلى فريقنا وتحقيق النجاح في سوق العقارات الديناميكي. ستكون مسؤوليتك الأساسية هي استقطاب العملاء وتقديم استشارات متخصصة حول فرص الاستثمار العقاري المتاحة. انضمي إلينا وكوني جزءًا من قصة نجاح عقارية مميزة. المهام والمسؤوليات: * استقطاب العملاء المحتملين وتحديد احتياجاتهم العقارية. * تقديم عروض تقديمية احترافية للمشاريع العقارية وشرح مميزاتها. * متابعة العملاء وتقديم الدعم اللازم لإتمام عمليات البيع. * بناء علاقات قوية ومستدامة مع العملاء. * تحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة بفعالية. -يشترط وجود خبرة لاتقل عن 3 سنوات . -وجود داتا خاصة أو عملاء خاصيين . -يفضل وجود سيارة ورخصة فال .

c93f64e41aabd86a.description: About Ghithaa Ghithaa (غِذاء) is seeking an Events Planner to join its team in Jeddah, Makkah. This is a full-time position for professionals with 2-5 years of experience in event planning and execution. Role Overview The Events Planner is responsible for managing Ghithaa's participation in relevant external events and for conceptualizing and executing original brand events. This role involves identifying strategic opportunities, fostering brand partnerships, developing new event concepts, and overseeing all aspects of event management from initial idea to post-event wrap-up, ensuring alignment with the company's marketing strategy. Key Responsibilities Maintain a current calendar of fitness, wellness, food, lifestyle, corporate, and community events across KSA. Evaluate each event based on audience fit, reach, cost, and potential for sign-ups, then recommend participation or sponsorship and negotiate terms. Initiate and secure co-hosted events with gyms, studios, sports brands, clinics, corporations, and lifestyle brands. Ensure each collaboration delivers measurable value, such as leads, subscriptions, content, or exposure, and maintain active partner relationships. Develop original event concepts for Ghithaa, including pop-ups, tastings, challenges, community runs, and workshops. Present each concept as a concise proposal detailing objectives, target audience, budget, potential partners, and anticipated results. Manage the end-to-end execution of all approved events, covering budget management, venue selection, permit acquisition, vendor coordination, logistics, staffing, and kitchen catering. Coordinate content coverage before, during, and after events, and provide a comprehensive wrap-up report on attendance, sign-ups, expenditure versus budget, and lessons learned. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in event planning and execution. Demonstrated ability to manage events from concept development to completion. Experience in negotiating partnerships and managing vendor relationships. Preferred Skills Familiarity with KSA event permit processes. Basic knowledge of event production elements, including sound, staging, and branding. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah.

c97b3d0caef20d80.description: About the Role HUDSON is seeking an experienced Sales Manager - Diesel Generators to join their team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is based in Dammam, Riyadh, or Jeddah and requires a professional with a strong background in power solutions. Role Overview The Sales Manager will be responsible for driving sales and business development for diesel generators and power solutions across various key sectors. This role involves strategic planning, customer relationship management, and project oversight to achieve revenue and growth objectives. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve revenue and business growth targets. Drive business development across Oil & Gas, Construction, Industrial, Infrastructure, Data Centers, Rental, and Government sectors. Develop and maintain relationships with key customers, consultants, contractors, and EPC companies. Manage major projects, tenders, commercial negotiations, and key accounts. Provide technical and commercial guidance on diesel generators and power solutions. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and new business opportunities. Coordinate with engineering, service, and operations teams to ensure customer satisfaction. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field. 10-12 years of overall experience in diesel generator sales, power generation, or power solutions. Minimum of 4-5 years of experience in Saudi Arabia in a Sales Manager or equivalent sales leadership position. Strong technical and commercial knowledge of generator systems, including generator sizing, synchronization, AMF/ATS, and power solutions. Experience with brands such as Cummins, Perkins, FG Wilson, Mitsubishi, MTU, Volvo Penta, Kohler, AKSA, Caterpillar, or similar brands is preferred. Proven track record in business development, team management, key account management, and achieving sales targets. Excellent communication, negotiation, and client relationship management skills. A Saudi driving license is preferred. Compensation The salary for this position is SAR 13,000-14,000 per month, offered as an all-inclusive package. Location This role is based in the Eastern Region of Saudi Arabia, with primary locations in Dammam, Riyadh, or Jeddah.

c9655f1fcb1112fa.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث فرع شركة تشاينا ناشيونال كيميكال انجنيرنج ثيرد كونستركشن كمباني عن كاتب علاقات حكومية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على متابعة المعاملات الإدارية والحكومية المتعلقة بالمشروع والعاملين، وضمان إنجاز الإجراءات بكفاءة وفي الوقت المحدد. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمعلومات المتعلقة بالوثائق والمتطلبات اللازمة لإصدار وتجديد بطاقات تعريف العاملين وتصاريح الدخول إلى مواقع المشاريع. التنسيق مع إدارة المشروع والعميل والجهات المختصة لاستكمال الإجراءات والمعاملات المطلوبة بسرعة وفعالية وفقاً للسياسات المعتمدة. إعداد وتحديث واستكمال النماذج والمستندات المتعلقة بالعاملين وتصاريح الدخول إلى مواقع العمل. متابعة صلاحية البطاقات والتصاريح واتخاذ الإجراءات اللازمة لتجديدها في المواعيد المحددة. التنسيق والتواصل مع الجهات الحكومية والمؤسسات والهيئات الأخرى ذات العلاقة بالمشروع. تقديم الوثائق والمستندات والمعلومات المطلوبة، ومتابعة المعاملات والإجراءات اللازمة وفقاً للأنظمة والتعليمات المعتمدة. حفظ الوثائق والسجلات وتنظيمها وتحديثها. متابعة معاملات العاملين بالتنسيق مع الأقسام المعنية وممثلي العميل. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على توفير المستندات والمعلومات المطلوبة لضمان إنجاز المعاملات والإجراءات بكفاءة. المهارات المطلوبة إتقان اللغتين العربية والإنجليزية بطلاقة في التواصل الشفهي والمراسلات الرسمية. مهارات تنظيمية عالية والقدرة على إدارة الوثائق والسجلات. مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتنسيق مع الأطراف الداخلية والخارجية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية، ويكون العمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى دعم العمليات الإدارية والحكومية للمشاريع. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

c9d12459d850a1ea.description: We are seeking an organized and detail-oriented Document Controller to provide document management and administrative support, ensuring the accurate handling, recording, distribution, and maintenance of company documents and correspondence. The role is responsible for managing incoming and outgoing documentation, maintaining structured filing systems, updating document registers, preparing administrative reports, and ensuring the timely retrieval and distribution of records. The successful candidate will support efficient document control processes while maintaining accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance with established company procedures. Responsibilities Receive, sort, register, classify, and distribute incoming and outgoing documents, correspondence, and official communications. Maintain and update document registers, filing systems, indexes, and records to ensure proper tracking and easy retrieval of information. Ensure documents are properly identified, numbered, categorized, filed, and maintained in accordance with established procedures. Monitor document movements and maintain accurate records of document submissions, approvals, revisions, and distributions. Prepare, type, format, and process letters, reports, forms, memos, and other official documentation. Coordinate with internal departments and external parties to facilitate the timely submission, circulation, and retrieval of documents. Maintain accurate administrative records, including attendance, timekeeping, and other relevant documentation. Ensure proper handling, storage, and confidentiality of sensitive company documents and records. Operate office equipment, including scanners, printers, photocopiers, and other document management tools. Monitor office stationery and document-related supplies and coordinate replenishment when required. Handle telephone inquiries, receive visitors, and provide general administrative assistance when required. Support the supervisor in daily document control and clerical activities and perform other related duties as assigned. Associate Degree or Diploma in any Engineering discipline. Minimum 3 years of experience in document control, records management, or administrative support. Basic knowledge of document control procedures, filing systems, and document management practices. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly MS Word, Excel, and Outlook. Good written and verbal communication skills in Arabic and English. Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to manage multiple documents, maintain records, and meet deadlines. Good coordination and communication skills to interact effectively with internal departments and external stakeholders. Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive documentation professionally.

c91052301ae871d1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الاخوان المتحدون عن أخصائي عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور على تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة المتعلقة بدوام الموظفين وإجازاتهم، بالإضافة إلى التعامل مع استفساراتهم وشكواهم بمهنية عالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة والنماذج الخاصة بمراقبة دوام موظفي الفروع وإجازاتهم المتنوعة، وتعديل النماذج عند الحاجة، مع تطبيق نظام مراقبة الحضور وضمان الالتزام بأوقات الدوام الرسمي. تطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الإجازات السنوية والمرضية والطارئة وغيرها من الإجازات المحددة في سياسة العطل والإجازات المعتمدة. تطبيق إجراءات الترقيات والإعارة وانتهاء الخدمة، وتسجيل كافة وقوعات الموظفين وفقاً للأنظمة والإجراءات المعتمدة. التعامل مع شكاوى وملاحظات وطلبات واستفسارات الموظفين بطريقة مهنية، ورفع المشاكل إلى مدير الإدارة بفعالية عند الضرورة. تحديث المعلومات المتعلقة بالموظفين وتزويدها لفريق خدمات الموظفين، من خلال تسجيل وتوثيق جميع المعلومات المتعلقة بالترقيات والدورات التدريبية والأمور المتعلقة بالرواتب والامتيازات. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بعمليات الموارد البشرية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة بعمليات الموارد البشرية. القدرة على تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة والنماذج بدقة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في التعامل مع الموظفين وحل المشكلات. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. مهارات تنظيمية عالية والقدرة على تحديث البيانات بدقة. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي عمليات الموارد البشرية بدوام كامل في المدينة المنورة ضمن فريق شركة الاخوان المتحدون، ويكون مسؤولاً عن دعم العمليات اليومية للموارد البشرية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

c91d5003c482d2da.description: About the Role KBR, Inc. is seeking a Static Technician II to join their team in the Makkah region, specifically in Rabigh or Makkah. Role Overview The Static Technician II plays a supportive role in ensuring the efficient execution of construction and maintenance projects within the plant. This includes a variety of hands-on tasks, requiring adaptability and adherence to safety protocols. The role is integral to maintaining operational efficiency and safety standards. Key Responsibilities Assist Pipefitters in performing diverse tasks for plant construction and maintenance. Transfer between different tasks as directed by supervisors. Complete and maintain accurate records related to work performed. Ensure proper maintenance of tools and equipment. Perform various clean-up and housekeeping activities to maintain a safe and organized work environment. Observe and strictly follow all established safety rules and procedures, including the mandatory use of personal safety equipment. Undertake other duties and activities as directed by management. Understanding and adherence to industrial safety standards and procedures. The role operates within a plant environment, requiring a commitment to safety and operational guidelines. c9211aa71a42a161.description: About the Role Converge is seeking an experienced Marketing Manager for a contract position in Jeddah, Makkah. This role is a maternity cover, requiring immediate availability to ensure continuity across the marketing function. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading the planning and execution of marketing activities, aligning brand initiatives and campaigns with business objectives. Key Responsibilities Lead the planning and execution of marketing activities. Ensure brand initiatives and campaigns are aligned with business objectives. Oversee marketing plans, brand development, and promotional activities. Monitor market trends and campaign performance to identify growth opportunities. Manage integrated marketing campaigns, brand communications, and promotional activities. Manage marketing budgets and coordinate with external agencies and suppliers. Strong background in developing and executing marketing strategies and brand plans. Understanding of market trends, consumer behavior, and competitor activity. Candidates must be available to join immediately.

c934b8470d9821bc.description: Showroom Sales Executive at Jazeera Paints Jazeera Paints is seeking a Showroom Sales Executive for a full-time position in Riyadh. This role is responsible for implementing the showroom sales plan to achieve assigned sales targets and ensuring a high standard of customer service and operational efficiency within the showroom. Key Responsibilities Welcome customers, provide high-standard customer service, and ensure their needs are met. Handle product handovers and provide pre-sales and after-sales customer support. Supervise showroom operations and inventory, ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures. Assist customers with product introductions, requirement identification, quantity determination, color coordination, and product selection. Ensure accurate order processing, invoicing, and product delivery. Coordinate showroom personnel activities, including assistants, laborers, and drivers, for efficient operations. Maintain showroom cleanliness, organization, and overall presentation. Ensure availability of marketing materials such as brochures, leaflets, and product catalogs. Achieve assigned sales targets in accordance with the approved sales plan and implement management objectives and KPIs. Receive and process customer orders through online channels, updating the e-commerce platform with accurate product and inventory levels. Ensure adequate stock availability across all product categories, especially fast-moving items. Apply stock replenishment procedures by requesting products from warehouses based on established minimum and maximum stock levels. Ensure compliance with the First-In, First-Out (FIFO) principle to minimize slow-moving and obsolete inventory. Report missing or unavailable products at the central warehouse to the direct manager promptly. Report damage, equipment malfunctions, or maintenance requirements to the direct supervisor and follow up on corrective actions. Maintain accountability for all showroom assets, including equipment, tools, and supplies; conduct inventory counts and reconcile balances. Ensure accurate and timely daily closing processes, including proper handling of customer advance payments. Execute assigned marketing programs and initiatives, including product campaigns and field visits to residential development areas. Maintain the showroom's overall appearance and ensure all employees comply with approved uniform and dress code requirements. Promote and sell all company product ranges to achieve sales targets and maximize sales opportunities. Ensure availability and proper condition of safety equipment, reporting any non-compliance, including valid Civil Defense and municipal licenses, fire extinguisher condition, and vehicle roadworthiness and documentation. Ensure implementation and compliance with the company's terms, conditions, and requirements governing the Ashanak program. Comply with company policies, procedures, and established guidelines. Execute activities related to the function using safe and environmentally sound methods. Perform any other duties assigned by the direct supervisor or manager. Work Type This is a full-time position. Location The role is based in Riyadh.

c93fbfdd96b2fba7.description: About KBR, Inc. KBR, Inc. is a company driven by innovators, thinkers, creators, explorers, volunteers, and dreamers, united by the goal of improving the world responsibly and safely. The company attracts a diverse workforce and top talent, fostering an environment where expertise thrives on creativity, resourcefulness, and collaboration. Role Summary KBR is seeking an Instrument Technician for a full-time position in the Eastern region. This role is crucial for ensuring the reliability and availability of instrument assets, thereby maintaining the operational continuity of process units. The Instrument Technician will lead, supervise, and coordinate the daily activities of instrument maintenance teams, focusing on compliance with preventive maintenance plans and effective breakdown maintenance. Key Responsibilities Lead, supervise, and coordinate the activities of maintenance technician teams, ensuring compliance with preventive maintenance plans and efficient execution of breakdown maintenance on Instrument systems, equipment, and facilities. Oversee the execution of monthly and weekly maintenance plans, controlling and submitting regular progress reports. Provide onsite maintenance and repairs for various instruments, including generators, transformers, and motors, ensuring adherence to standards, specifications, safety procedures, manufacturer’s recommendations, and contract terms. Serve as the focal point for the daily Instrument maintenance execution plan, supervising and coordinating technician activities across all Instrument systems, plant, equipment, and facilities within the designated area. Conduct frequent site visits to ensure proper work execution and monitor technician activities during routine maintenance. Follow up on Instrument maintenance work progress, submit regular reports with recommendations to the Instrument foreman, and maintain records of daily maintenance works against planned programs, preparing completion reports as applicable. Assist in implementing engineering modifications and enhancements to Instrument equipment by providing recommendations to improve the suitability and serviceability of Instrument systems. Demonstrate proactive safety aptitude and behavior in all tasks. Required Qualifications and Experience Minimum 7 years of experience in Oil & Gas maintenance, with a relevant Diploma. Strong technical understanding of maintenance management for Oil & Gas Facilities. Proven leadership skills within large organizations. Maturity of judgment under pressure and the ability to resolve problems effectively. Strategic management skills. Ability to achieve business results in a multi-cultural environment. Flexibility to travel internationally and reside in KSA. Skills and Knowledge Strong knowledge of maintaining and repairing Instrument systems. Good knowledge of Instrument equipment design, installation, and maintenance. Strong knowledge of maintaining and repairing Mechanical and electro-hydraulic systems. Strong knowledge of standards, procedures, and regulations pertaining to Health, Safety, and Environmental preservation. Strong communication and people skills. Good command of oral and written English. Application Information This full-time position requires 5-10 years of experience. Salary information will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

c94357524491f151.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ايساف الدولية عن فني ميكانيكي محركات للانضمام إلى فريقها في نجران. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية متابعة تركيب المحركات الميكانيكية، وتحديد القطع التبديلية ومطابقة مواصفاتها، بالإضافة إلى فحص وتشخيص أعطال المحركات ومتابعة إصلاحها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة تركيب المحركات الميكانيكية والإشراف على إجراءات تشغيلها. تحديد القطع التبديلية اللازمة، والتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية، والعمل على تأمينها. تنفيذ إجراءات استلام المحركات الميكانيكية بغرض الخدمة والإصلاح. فحص وتشخيص الأعطال الفنية في المحركات ومتابعة عمليات إصلاحها. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة في جميع مراحل العمل. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ميكانيكا المحركات. معرفة قوية بتركيب المحركات الميكانيكية وإجراءات تشغيلها. القدرة على تحديد القطع التبديلية ومطابقة مواصفاتها. مهارات ممتازة في فحص وتشخيص أعطال المحركات ومتابعة إصلاحها. بيئة العمل يعمل فني ميكانيكي المحركات بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة ايساف الدولية في مدينة نجران. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالمعايير المهنية وإجراءات السلامة المتبعة في بيئة العمل. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الموقع: نجران. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة ايساف الدولية.

The primary objective is to proactively ensure a safe and secure working environment for both staff and visitors, contributing to the overall operational integrity of the group. Conduct regular walk-throughs and thorough security inspections of assigned facilities to identify and address potential vulnerabilities. Investigate all accidents or security incidents that occur during the assigned shift, generating comprehensive reports with all necessary supporting documentation. Execute all assigned duties and functions using safe and environmentally responsible methods. Perform any additional duties as assigned by the direct supervisor or manager. c92f0be683d24815.description: Namaa Partners is hiring a Junior Operations Analyst to support the operational side of the firm's mandates: the reporting, tracking and working documents that let a principal walk into a board or committee meeting with numbers that hold up. The hire carries the recurring cadence from the start, keeping engagement reporting accurate and current across active mandates, and building a clear operating picture of how the firm runs its work. This is an entry-level role with real accountability for the material other people rely on. You will work from Riyadh on a hybrid basis, alongside principals and analysts. About Namaa Partners Namaa Partners is a strategy advisory firm working mostly with organizations in Saudi Arabia and with companies that have significant interests there. The work covers corporate strategy, growth and market entry, operating model and efficiency, organization and talent, digital strategy, performance improvement, and governance and risk. Clients include family groups and their holding companies, listed corporations, private equity portfolio companies, banks and insurers, government entities, and industrial operators. Principals scope the mandates and then deliver them, so the analysis that enters a decision is the analysis of the people who signed it. What You Will Do Maintain the active mandate tracker: engagement status, key dates, named owners and the next decision point, updated weekly and circulated before Monday. Build and refresh the reporting packs that principals take into board and committee meetings, checking that every figure traces back to its source before it leaves the office. Sit in on internal scoping and staffing conversations, take the notes, and turn them into a short written record with owners and dates attached. Pull together the firm's operating data on mandate pipeline, utilization and engagement economics, and flag where the numbers have moved. Prepare the first draft of client working documents such as issue logs, action registers and meeting minutes, then revise them with the principal who owns the mandate. Keep templates and reference material for recurring deliverables consistent, so a new engagement does not start from a blank page. What We Need From You A bachelor's degree, or an equivalent record of structured analytical work you can describe plainly. Comfort with spreadsheets and slide decks: you can build a clean model of a small dataset and format a page without being asked to fix it twice. Writing that another person can read once and act on. Short sentences, clear headings, no filler. Care with numbers. You check a total against its parts before you send it, not after someone asks. Arabic and English, spoken and written, at a level that lets you follow a client conversation and write up what was decided. Willingness to ask what a term means when a client uses it and you are not certain, rather than guessing at it in a document. How Decisions Get Made The principal who scopes a mandate staffs it and stays with it through delivery. They set what the engagement needs week to week and sign off on anything that goes to a client. As the analyst on a mandate, you report to that principal and to the engagement lead they name, and your tracking documents are part of how they judge where a piece of work actually stands. If something is slipping, the expectation is that you raise it early in plain terms rather than at the deadline. Your read on the numbers is one of the inputs before a decision is taken. What The Role Offers This is a permanent, full-time position based in Riyadh, working on a hybrid arrangement. You will see how mandates are scoped and staffed from the inside, sit close to the working sessions where a view gets formed, and learn what a defensible number looks like when a board is asking about it. The exposure spans family groups, listed corporations, financial institutions and government entities, across strategy, operating model and performance work. It is a role for someone who wants to learn the craft by doing the operational part of it properly. People do well here when they write, when they are comfortable working through ambiguity in a client's own vocabulary, and when they are content to be accountable for a number. You will often be given a question and a rough deadline rather than a set of steps. What matters is that the tracker is current, the pack is right, and the principal who opens it knows what it says before the meeting starts. If that way of working suits you, the first year will be spent learning more about how decisions get made than most junior roles allow.

c9b83aaf82033af5.description: Sanabil Studio is a venture builder that blends industry expertise, technology, and startup know-how to turn bold ideas into real businesses.
